name: Rods
description: Rod blanks: length, rating, action, and the special rods you find.

pages.title: Rods
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A **rod blank** is the base: its length, the load it holds, its casting range.
- The **Bamboo Pole** needs no reel; every other rod does.
- The **Heavy Boat Rod** lands tuna and sharks.
- The **Netherite Rod** fishes lava.

A blank has a **length** (longer casts further), a **load** it holds before it is overloaded, an **action** and a casting range in grams.\
\
**Action**: a fast rod bends at the tip, a slow one along the whole blank. Slow blanks soak shocks best; fast ones put the load through quicker. Rods bend toward the line as the load grows.
**Bamboo Pole**: 4 m, holds 4 kg, slow, casts 1-15 g. No reel and no drag: a fixed 8 m of line. 150 uses.
**Wooden Rod**: 2.1 m, holds 5 kg, moderate, 2-20 g. 250 uses. A plain rod of 3 sticks and 2 string is one too.
**Iron Rod**: 2.4 m, holds 9 kg, fast, 5-30 g. 450 uses.
**Steel Telescopic Rod**: 3 m, holds 16 kg, fast, 8-45 g. Slides out on the cast. 800 uses. Any steel works.
**Heavy Boat Rod**: 2.1 m, holds 45 kg, moderate, casts 30-200 g. The rod for tuna, arapaima and sharks, by hand or on a boat. 1200 uses.

pages.title: Netherite Rod
pages.text: Smith a Steel Telescopic Rod with a netherite ingot and a Netherite Upgrade. 2.7 m, holds 30 kg, fast, 10-80 g. Fireproof and **fishes in lava**. 2000 uses.

**Found, not made** (600 uses each):

- **Rod of Resonance**: ancient city chests. On a bite it tells you what took the bait.
- **Prismarine Fishing Rod**: dropped by Elder Guardians. In rain, faster bites and +1 luck.

- **Suncatcher**: a rare catch in plains. +1 luck in sunshine.
- **Rod of the Hero**: an expert Fisherman villager sells it for 15 emeralds. A bonus village item with every catch.
- **Blazing Fishing Rod**: nether fortress chests. Fishes lava, and catches Nether lava fish in any lava.

- **Beeline**: 1 time in 20 when you harvest honeycomb from a full hive.
- **Midas Fishing Rod**: smith an Iron Rod with a **Midas Fish**, string as the template. +1 luck and a bonus gold item with every catch.\
\
Special rods take the same parts as any other.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Special rod blanks: Rod of Resonance 2.4 m, 10 kg; Prismarine 2.7 m, 12 kg; Suncatcher and Rod of the Hero 2.1 m, 7 kg; Blazing 2.7 m, 20 kg; Beeline 2.1 m, 8 kg, slow; Midas 2.4 m, 12 kg.\
\
Alloyed's Steel Fishing Rod is a Steel Telescopic Rod wherever one turns up.

Older rods turn into these when a world loads them: Stone Fishing Rods become Wooden Rods; Iron and Golden ones, Iron Rods; Crystal and Diamond ones, Steel Telescopic Rods; Netherite ones, Netherite Rods. Their line, hook, bobber and bait come along, with a reel to match.
